# New York Magazine

> New York Magazine is a leading digital media outlet covering politics, culture, entertainment, lifestyle, and consumer recommendations with flagship sections including Intelligencer, The Strategist, and brand publications.

New York Magazine operates as a comprehensive news and lifestyle platform with multiple vertical brands including Intelligencer (politics and breaking news), The Strategist (product recommendations and deals), and specialized publications like Vulture, The Cut, and Curbed. The site combines traditional journalism with consumer-focused content and newsletter distribution.

## Key Topics

- Politics & Breaking News
- Product Recommendations
- Gift Guides & Deals
- AI & Technology
- Entertainment & Culture
- Fashion & Lifestyle
- Home & Kitchen
- Travel & Gear
- Trump Administration
- Beauty & Wellness
- News Aggregation
- Print Subscriptions
- Newsletter Signup
- Intelligencer
- The Strategist

## Core Sections

- [New York Magazine Homepage](https://nymag.com): New York Magazine homepage covering culture, politics, entertainment, and lifestyle
- [Intelligencer – News & Politics](https://nymag.com/intelligencer): Intelligencer news section with daily politics, business, tech, and breaking news
- [The Strategist – Products & Deals](https://nymag.com/strategist): The Strategist product recommendations, deals, and gift guides

## The Strategist – Shopping & Recommendations

- [Gift Guides](https://nymag.com/strategist/gift-guides): The Strategist gift guides for various occasions and recipients
- [Deals & Sales](https://nymag.com/strategist/deals-sales): The Strategist deals and sales aggregation across categories
- [Beauty](https://nymag.com/strategist/beauty): The Strategist beauty product recommendations and reviews
- [Fashion & Style](https://nymag.com/strategist/fashion): The Strategist fashion and style recommendations for all demographics
- [Home & Furniture](https://nymag.com/strategist/home): The Strategist home goods recommendations and buying guides
- [Kitchen & Cooking](https://nymag.com/strategist/kitchen): The Strategist kitchen products and cooking equipment recommendations
- [Travel & Luggage](https://nymag.com/strategist/travel): The Strategist travel gear and luggage recommendations

## News & Technology
